edges.label: Loeb's Harvard base; launched the project from here
edges.note: The overview paper gives Loeb's affiliation as 'Head of the Galileo Project, Astronomy Department, Harvard University, 60 Garden Street, Cambridge, MA 02138', and dates the project's first year as August 2021 through July 2022.

edges.label: first Galileo Observatory, Harvard College Observatory roof
edges.note: Figure 1 of the project's own overview paper captions the 'First all-sky Galileo Observatory for UAP on the roof of the Harvard College Observatory (Cambridge, MA)'. This is the physical instrument site for the instrumented search, not merely an administrative address.
